shared_elements: carved stone surface with shallow low-relief incision
horizontal band dividing the composition into zones
rectangular framed panel or cartouche-like elements
justification: Both are grey stone monuments whose surfaces carry shallow, linear low-relief motifs including anthropomorphic faces, disc/ring forms and horizontal banding that divides the field into registers or zones. The decisive differences are format and mode: A is a flat, roughly rectangular slab bearing a pictorial multi-figure scene set above a glyph-like basal band, while B is a massive three-dimensional figure in the round whose ornament is a sparse set of body markings distributed over a modelled head and torso.
